text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Hey... how did I... do?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Am I... number one?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Scarlet! Scaaarlet!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race! I'm not
forgetting this
one anytime soon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That sure was something! The best race
I've ever
seen—no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I did it... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe. How about that?! I won!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The energy drains out of Daiwa Scarlet,
as though
her tightly wound nerves have
finally relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaah... I feel alive again!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you look about ready
to pass
out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Vodka?! What are you—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't get your socks in a twist. I'm... I'm
here to
say congrats.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing. You've gotten so
strong, and...
You really were the
number one Umamusume out
there
today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So I... Uh... I guess what I mean is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I think I finally get what you mean when
you talk
about being number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh? Took you long enough.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on! Why do you gotta talk
down to—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You know, I only realized it myself after
this race
was over.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line, hearing the
cheers, seeing
the expressions on every
face in the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I thought to myself, "I've done it. I'm
their number
one." But that's when it
came to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When I say I want to be number one,
what I really
mean is... I want to be the
Umamusume that lives
on in their
memories.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When they hear the words "autumn
Tenno Sho," I
want them to remember
the time they saw me
race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And when they think about
Umamusume, I want
the first name that
pops into their heads to be
"Daiwa
Scarlet."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y'know, that doesn't sound half bad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...But I'll still get you next time! The next
race is
gonna be mine for sure!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Go on, hurry back overseas.
You've
still got that warrior's pilgrimage
of yours or
whatever, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You better work your butt off if you
want any
hope of beating me. Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I break up the budding argument,
we make
our way back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, what else do I need to do to
become
number one?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Correct! Hehe, you do know your stuff!
choice_data_list: 『有馬記念』でみんなの1番になる

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then it's time for me to become the
number one
Umamusume, just like we
always planned!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I promise Daiwa Scarlet that I'll bring her
victory
in the Arima Kinen.
